questions.question: Who conceived Python, and at which research institute in the Netherlands did that happen?

required_facts.fact: Python was conceived by Guido van Rossum at Centrum Wiskunde & Informatica (CWI) in the Netherlands

questions.question: What does Python use instead of curly brackets or keywords to delimit blocks?

required_facts.fact: Python uses whitespace indentation to delimit blocks

questions.question: Since Python 3.0, what kind of division does the single slash operator always represent?

required_facts.fact: Since Python 3.0, / always represents floating-point division

questions.question: What is the reference implementation of Python, and in which language is that implementation written?

required_facts.fact: CPython is the reference implementation of Python
CPython is written in C

questions.question: Which Python implementation uses a just-in-time compiler, and which transpiler compiles a superset of Python to C?

required_facts.fact: PyPy uses a just-in-time compiler
Cython compiles a superset of Python to C

questions.question: What is Python's reference implementation, and what is commonly cited as one of the greatest strengths of Python?

required_facts.fact: CPython is the reference implementation of Python
Python's large standard library is commonly cited as one of its greatest strengths

questions.question: Who created C++, and in what year was it first released?

required_facts.fact: C++ was created by Bjarne Stroustrup
C++ was first released in 1985

questions.question: In what year did Bjarne Stroustrup begin work on the C++ predecessor "C with Classes"?

required_facts.fact: Stroustrup began work on C with Classes in 1979

questions.question: What does the C++ name signify, and who is credited with that name?

required_facts.fact: The C++ name signifies the evolutionary nature of the changes from C
Rick Mascitti is credited with the C++ name

questions.question: In what year was C++ first standardized by ISO, and what was that standard informally called?

required_facts.fact: C++ was first standardized by ISO in 1998
The first ISO C++ standard was informally known as C++98

questions.question: What are the two main components of the C++ language?

required_facts.fact: C++ has a direct mapping of hardware features provided primarily by the C subset
C++ has zero-overhead abstractions based on those mappings

questions.question: Is C++ strictly a superset of C?

required_facts.fact: C++ is often considered a superset of C but this is not strictly true

questions.question: Which kind of programming language is Haskell, and after whom is it named?

required_facts.fact: Haskell is a statically typed, purely functional programming language with type inference and lazy evaluation
Haskell is named after logician Haskell Curry

questions.question: What did the Haskell standardization series culminate in during late 1997?

required_facts.fact: In late 1997 the series culminated in Haskell 98
Haskell 98 was intended to specify a stable, minimal, portable version of the language and accompanying standard library

questions.question: On what date was the GHC2021 language edition released, and with which GHC version?

required_facts.fact: GHC2021 was released on 29 October 2021
GHC2021 was released with GHC version 9.2.1

questions.question: Does Haskell provide lazy evaluation and pattern matching?

required_facts.fact: Haskell features lazy evaluation
Haskell features pattern matching

questions.question: To what two kinds of output does the Glasgow Haskell Compiler compile?

required_facts.fact: GHC compiles to native code on many processor architectures
GHC compiles to ANSI C

questions.question: Which Haskell implementation is a bytecode interpreter, and which two Haskell dialects target the Java virtual machine?

required_facts.fact: Hugs is a bytecode interpreter
Eta and Frege are Haskell dialects targeting the Java virtual machine

questions.question: Who created the C programming language, and in what year?

required_facts.fact: C was created in 1972 by Dennis Ritchie

questions.question: Who published the first edition of The C Programming Language, and in what year?

required_facts.fact: Brian Kernighan and Dennis Ritchie published the first edition in 1978

questions.question: When was C17 published, and did it introduce new language features?

required_facts.fact: C17 was published in June 2018
C17 introduces no new language features, only technical corrections and clarifications

questions.question: How many reserved words did C89 have, and how many more words did C23 reserve?

required_facts.fact: C89 has 32 reserved words
C23 reserved fifteen more words

questions.question: In C, what kind of information does a pointer record?

required_facts.fact: A pointer records the address or location of an object or function in memory

questions.question: Which three memory allocation approaches does C distinguish, and what can improper use of malloc and free lead to?

required_facts.fact: C distinguishes static, automatic, and dynamic memory allocation
Improper use of malloc and free can lead to memory leaks and dangling pointers
